author: pereanub
title: iGPU unit tests job fails uploading test results - blob storage returns HTML error page
signature: artifact upload to blob storage failed html error page returned during finalizeartifact|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: iGPU Tests (unit) / GPU
failed_jobs.symptom: All 29664 unit tests passed, but the 'Upload Test Results' step failed: FinalizeArtifact call to Actions blob storage returned an HTML error page instead of JSON

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check failed because of the downstream iGPU Tests (unit) / GPU job failure

key_errors: Beginning upload of artifact content to blob storage
##[error]<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"> <head> <meta charset="UTF-8"> ... (Actions artifact/blob storage service returned a generic HTML error page instead of a JSON API response)
root_cause: All 29664 iGPU unit test cases passed; the job only failed in the post-test 'Upload Test Results' step. actions/upload-artifact's call to begin uploading artifact content to GitHub Actions blob storage received an HTML error page (a generic backend/proxy error page) instead of the expected JSON API response, roughly 11 seconds after the upload began. This matches a previously observed signature (first seen 2026-09-04 on an LLM accuracy iGPU run, PR #37898, same author) where the Actions blob-storage backend intermittently returns HTML instead of JSON during artifact finalization/upload - a transient GitHub Actions infrastructure issue unrelated to the PR's code changes (NPU remote-tensor import_size property, affecting only NPU plugin/docs files, not the GPU test suite).
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is a GitHub Actions Actions-service/blob-storage backend failure that occurs intermittently and is unrelated to code under test.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'iGPU Tests (unit) / GPU' job; the test suite itself passed (29664/29664) and only the artifact upload step failed transiently.
No code changes required for PR #39466 - the failure is unrelated to the NPU remote-properties changes, which do not touch the GPU plugin or its test suite.

If this recurs frequently, consider wrapping the 'Upload Test Results' step with continue-on-error (since it only uploads informational test result JSON) or adding retry/backoff so a transient blob-storage hiccup does not fail an otherwise fully-passing job.
prevention_strategies: Wrap non-critical result-artifact uploads (test result JSON/XML for reporting only) with retry logic or continue-on-error so a transient backend blip does not fail an otherwise-passing job. Monitor GitHub Actions status page and this recurring signature to distinguish one-off blips from a systemic issue with the self-hosted iGPU runner's network path to the blob storage service.
historical_context: Matches signature_hash 841a57c639e28d01, first seen 2026-09-04 (run 33854130288, PR #37898, LLM accuracy iGPU tests, same author pereanub) and also observed 2026-10-10 (run 38073966332, PR #38105, TensorFlow Layer Tests) under a closely related signature - both prior occurrences were the same Actions blob-storage service returning an HTML error page during artifact finalization/upload, confirmed transient and resolved by re-running the job.
